import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int from, to;
        double capacity;
        Edge(int s, int d, double cap) {
            from = s;
            to = d;
            capacity = cap;
        }
    }

    static class Vertex {
        List<Integer> incident_edges = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    static class Network {
        List<Vertex> vertices = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();

        Network(int V, int E_capacity) {
            for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
                vertices.add(new Vertex());
            }
            edges.ensureCapacity(E_capacity);
        }

        void link(int u, int v, double cap) {
            edges.add(new Edge(u, v, cap));
            vertices.get(u).incident_edges.add(edges.size() - 1);
        }

        List<Integer> find_path(int src, int dst, double[] flow, double[] bottleneck) {
            PriorityQueue<int[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> Double.compare(b[0], a[0]));
            double[] best_cap = new double[vertices.size()];
            int[] prev_edge = new int[vertices.size()];
            Arrays.fill(best_cap, 0.0);
            Arrays.fill(prev_edge, -1);

            best_cap[src] = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
            pq.offer(new int[]{(int) best_cap[src], src});

            while (!pq.isEmpty() && best_cap[dst] == 0) {
                int[] item = pq.poll();
                double cap = item[0];
                int node = item[1];

                for (int eid : vertices.get(node).incident_edges) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(eid);
                    double residual = e.capacity - flow[eid];
                    if (residual > 0) {
                        double new_cap = Math.min(cap, residual);
                        if (new_cap > best_cap[e.to]) {
                            best_cap[e.to] = new_cap;
                            pq.offer(new int[]{(int) best_cap[e.to], e.to});
                            prev_edge[e.to] = eid;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            bottleneck[0] = best_cap[dst];
            List<Integer> path = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int e = prev_edge[dst]; e != -1; e = prev_edge[edges.get(e).from]) {
                path.add(e);
            }
            return path;
        }

        double flow(int source, int sink) {
            Network res = new Network(vertices.size(), edges.size() * 2);
            double[] f = new double[edges.size() * 2];

            for (int i = 0; i < edges.size(); i++) {
                res.link(edges.get(i).from, edges.get(i).to, edges.get(i).capacity);
                res.link(edges.get(i).to, edges.get(i).from, 0.0);
            }

            double total = 0.0;
            double[] cap = new double[1];
            List<Integer> path = res.find_path(source, sink, f, cap);
            while (!path.isEmpty() && cap[0] > 0) {
                for (int e : path) {
                    int rev = (e % 2 == 1) ? e - 1 : e + 1;
                    f[e] += cap[0];
                    f[rev] -= cap[0];
                }
                total += cap[0];
                path = res.find_path(source, sink, f, cap);
            }

            for (int eid : res.vertices.get(source).incident_edges) {
                total += f[eid];
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    static int n, T;
    static class Cell {
        int x, y;
        boolean[] affected = new boolean[61];
        boolean[] passable = new boolean[61];
        int scientists, capsules;

        Cell() {
            for (int i = 0; i < 61; i++) {
                passable[i] = true;
            }
        }

        int node_index(int t) {
            return 2 + x + n * y + n * n * t;
        }

        void quarantine() {
            for (int i = 0; i < 61; i++) {
                passable[i] = false;
            }
        }

        void infect(int t) {
            if (passable[t]) {
                passable[t] = false;
                affected[t] = true;
            }
        }

        void propagate(int t) {
            if (affected[t]) {
                infect(t + 1);
                if (x > 0) grid[x - 1][y].infect(t + 1);
                if (x < n - 1) grid[x + 1][y].infect(t + 1);
                if (y > 0) grid[x][y - 1].infect(t + 1);
                if (y < n - 1) grid[x][y + 1].infect(t + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    static Cell[][] grid = new Cell[10][10];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = scanner.nextInt();
        T = scanner.nextInt();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                grid[i][j] = new Cell();
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String row = scanner.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                grid[i][j].x = i;
                grid[i][j].y = j;
                if (row.charAt(j) == 'Y') {
                    grid[i][j].quarantine();
                } else if (row.charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    grid[i][j].infect(0);
                } else {
                    grid[i][j].scientists = row.charAt(j) - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String row = scanner.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (row.charAt(j) != 'Y' && row.charAt(j) != 'Z') {
                    grid[i][j].capsules = row.charAt(j) - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int step = 0; step <= T; step++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (step < T) {
                        grid[i][j].propagate(step);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Network net = new Network(n * n * (T + 1) + 2, 100 * 4 * 60);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                Cell cell = grid[i][j];
                if (cell.scientists > 0) {
                    net.link(0, cell.node_index(0), cell.scientists);
                }
                if (cell.capsules > 0) {
                    net.link(cell.node_index(T), 1, cell.capsules);
                }
                for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
                    if (cell.capsules > 0) {
                        net.link(cell.node_index(t), cell.node_index(T), 1000);
                    }
                    if (cell.passable[t]) {
                        if (i > 0 && grid[i - 1][j].passable[t]) {
                            net.link(cell.node_index(t), grid[i - 1][j].node_index(t + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (i < n - 1 && grid[i + 1][j].passable[t]) {
                            net.link(cell.node_index(t), grid[i + 1][j].node_index(t + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (j > 0 && grid[i][j - 1].passable[t]) {
                            net.link(cell.node_index(t), grid[i][j - 1].node_index(t + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (j < n - 1 && grid[i][j + 1].passable[t]) {
                            net.link(cell.node_index(t), grid[i][j + 1].node_index(t + 1), 1000);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println((int) net.flow(0, 1));
    }
}
